test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting to the immediate left of Q and immediate right of O. M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of L. P is sitting to the immediate left of L and immediate right of N. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Q and P?
solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R is sitting to the immediate left of Q and immediate right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5dadfba2ad1d99cb8eb8753148ee8a3157a933f4dd7d305c7522f46aba7af79.png] 

2) M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02f120a58295f4abb37609d567461c0c0133ec36aaaa2713e68b3aeb5f99d09c.png] 

3) P is sitting to the immediate left of L and immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9f8b3c6ddf7b6fd284b8a5e4c2bdf0ece8997f6592214880c216aba60d6d51.png] 

Thus, N is the immediate neighbour of both Q and P.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
